svg.text: Shard Draft v2 · element colors (Ghost GO 11:40Z): Ember #E84814 · Frost #5CD6FF · Void #C04888
Element = icon circle + shard + '+1 pip' footer. Rarity = 2 px card stroke + tier chip (Rarities.COLOR). The two never share a channel.
Same tier (Rare) so only the element color changes.
Each element at the 5 V1 tiers (Common → Legendary):
Void #C04888 vs Epic 186,96,240: pink-magenta vs purple, OK
Frost #5CD6FF vs Rare 72,142,255: cyan vs blue, closest pair;
tier chip word + stroke carry rarity, never the fill
Ember #E84814 vs Legendary 255,196,64: red-orange vs gold, OK
Footer text: Ember/Void white-tint, Frost uses its own cyan
Void follows #428/#435 (V3). If Kevin picks the V2 override,
cards follow the same Config value, no card change
